# Security policy

Shining holds a student's Samad login on their phone, and the market handles card numbers and forget codes. We take reports about any of that seriously.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please don't open a public issue for a security problem. Email [shining@nisatech.org](mailto:shining@nisatech.org) instead, in Persian or English, with:

- what the problem is and what an attacker could do with it;
- the steps to reproduce it, and the app version (shown in Settings);
- whether you've told anyone else.

We'll answer within a few days, keep you posted while we fix it, and say when the fix is released. Please give us a reasonable time to ship a fix before you talk about it publicly.

## What's in scope

- The Shining Android app in this repository, in its latest release.
- The Shining server the app talks to (menu alerts and the market). Its code is private, but reports about it are welcome here too.

Problems in Samad itself, the university's reservation system, aren't ours to fix: please report those to Sharif University.

## Supported versions

Only the latest release gets security fixes. Update from [Releases](https://github.com/Nisatech-org/shining-app/releases) or [Cafe Bazaar](https://cafebazaar.ir/app/app.shining).

## Please don't

- use other students' accounts, listings or trades to test;
- run automated scans or load tests against the Shining server or Samad;
- keep or share any personal data you come across.
